messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: inference-gateway-prod reporting increased 5xx (503/504) across eu-west1 for 6m. Error rate > 6% and customer-facing latency spikes. Alert: INF-GW-5XX-7265 https://ops.internal/alerts/INF-GW-5XX-7265

alex: ack. i'm taking primary. immediately gathering recent runner logs and host metrics.

marco: i'm seeing repeated OOMKills on model-runner-quant pods in eu-west1-zone-b. earliest OOM at 2026-03-15T08:22:41Z, repeated every ~30s. container status shows "OOMKilled", exit_code=137.

taylor: any new deploys or kernel/driver changes? mention of quant kernel changes in last canary?

marco: we rolled quant-kernel v2.4 at 2026-03-15T07:50; it introduces a new pooled allocator for CUDA memory. i toggled the feature flag off at 08:10 but rollout didn't complete; about 40% of runners still running v2.4.

jess: host dmesg shows repeated "GPU watchdog timeout" and nvml reports process crashes on GPU 0 & 1. nvlink errors also present. No host OOM.

alex: logs (truncated):
```
[2026-03-15T08:22:41Z] model-runner[pid=11223]: INFO loaded model: redwood-xl-13b-quant
[2026-03-15T08:23:02Z] model-runner[pid=11223]: ERROR cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (requested 2147483648)
[2026-03-15T08:23:02Z] model-runner[pid=11223]: ERROR Unhandled exception std::bad_alloc
[2026-03-15T08:23:03Z] kernel: NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[2026-03-15T08:23:04Z] model-runner: process 11223 exited with signal 11 (Segfault)
```

marco: looks like allocator path is not returning memory to cuda promptly; combined with KV cache growth from large batched requests -> fragmentation -> OOM.

taylor: immediate mitigation options:
- reroute traffic away from eu-west1 runners to us-central fallback pool (increase risk of added latency but reduces 5xx)
- scale up dedicated-pool-quantized and put live traffic there
- pin gateway to older model-variant (non-quant) until patch

alex: routing change in progress. i'm adjusting smart-routing to prefer fallback pools and to decrease batch sizes for eu-west1 to reduce per-request memory pressure. executing now.

ops-bot: routing update: traffic policy adjusted for inference-gateway-prod. 60% -> us-central-fallback, 30% -> dedicated-pool-quantized, 10% -> eu-west1 (reduced concurrency). Commit id: rtp-2026-03-15-7265

jess: after routing shift, eu-west1 5xx dropped to ~1.5% in 60s. customers still see degraded P95 latency for some calls routed to fallback (added ~120ms RTT).

support-bot: creating incident ticket INC-7265 and adding customer-impact channel. Notifying top 5 enterprise customers with potential degraded performance.

marco: root cause hypothesis: pooled allocator in v2.4 + delayed cudaFree semantics under heavy KV cache usage -> fragmentation leading to intermittent cudaMalloc failures and driver resets. My revert didn't reach all nodes; need immediate hotfix.

alex: plan:
1) keep routing away from eu-west1 until full hotpatch.
2) push hotfix binary that disables per-request pooling (force legacy allocator) and redeploy runners in eu-west1 with priority 2.
3) temporarily lower maximum batch size to 1 for quant models in eu-west1.
4) enable aggressive KV cache eviction for 10m.
5) run post-deploy smoke tests and monitor 5xx for 10m before bringing routing back.

taylor: i'll blackhole new model-variant traffic (xlm-large-quant-new) and ensure only vetted variants serve until this is closed.

marco: building hotpatch now. ETA ~8m for build+canary. will start canary on 2 nodes with telemetry flags to watch cudaMalloc counts and fragmentation metrics.

alex: if canary looks good, do rolling to remaining eu-west1 nodes with small batch concurrency. keep public routing shift until we see stable 5xx < 0.5% for 15m.

jess: also recommend we add a watchdog that detects repeated cudaMalloc failures per process and restarts process earlier to avoid GPU watchdog reset.

support-bot: status update message sent to customers at 2026-03-15T08:35Z: "We've detected elevated errors in EU cluster and rerouted traffic; working on a targeted hotfix. Some requests may see increased latency. We will update in 30 minutes."

marco: hotpatch canary started on node eu-west1-b-runner-12 at 08:40; initial telemetry shows no cudaMalloc errors for canary process after 90s. nvml shows stable GPU state.

alex: good. begin gradual rollout. leaving 10% traffic to eu-west1 for smoke.

ops-bot: deploy progress: 2/12 nodes updated. 0/2 errors.

jess: monitoring: eu-west1 5xx now 0.6% and trending down. nvml resets absent on patched nodes.

alex: rolling to remaining nodes. also notify on-call infra for driver-level inspection after rollout.

support-bot: customer update: "Hotfix being rolled; errors decreasing. We will confirm full recovery after final verification."

marco: final note: post-mortem action items:
- revert pooled allocator code path until stress-tested (assigned: marco)
- add integration test for pooled allocator under KV cache churn (assigned: eng-ml)
- add early-detect cudaMalloc-failure circuit in runner (assigned: eng-runtime)
- improve rollout canary coverage to avoid partial rollout with 40% unpatched

alex: excellent. handing off to oncall infra for long-term follow-up. closing live-incident channel in 30m unless issues reappear. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: incident INC-7265 acknowledged by alex. paging handoff to infra-oncall at 2026-03-15T09:05Z.
summary: Pager triggered by increased 5xx in eu-west1 caused by quant-kernel v2.4 pooled allocator leading to cudaMalloc OOMs and GPU resets. Immediate mitigations: route traffic to fallback pools, hotpatch disabling pooling, reduce batch sizes, aggressive KV cache eviction, customer notifications. Post-mortem action items listed.
